items.title: Launching External Web Access for Web Search on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Earlier this month, we announced Web Search on Amazon Bedrock , a built-in server-side tool that allows you to ground model responses with current web knowledge, while maintaining data within your secured AWS environment with zero data…

items.title: Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds domain and published date filtering, expands to Europe and Asia Pacific
items.blurb: Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now supports domain filtering and published-date filtering, giving agents per-request control over which web sources and time windows they search.

items.title: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection supports third-party models on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection now monitors spend on third-party foundation models running on Amazon Bedrock, such as Anthropic Claude and other provider-hosted models.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker notebooks now support trusted identity propagation
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker Notebooks now support Trusted Identity Propagation (TIP) with Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon EMR Serverless, enabling per-user access control for data analytics.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch log Centralization now supports log group tag propagation
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch Centralization now copies log group tags from source accounts to the destination log groups created by centralization rules.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines adds GeoIP, RDS, and XML processors
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines now includes three new processors that parse and enrich log data as it's ingested: an Amazon RDS log parser, an XML parser and a GeoIP enrichment processor.

items.title: Microsoft Releases Aspire 13.5 With a Refreshed Dashboard and Workflow Improvements
items.blurb: Last week, Microsoft released Aspire 13.5, an update that refreshes the dashboard and the aspire.dev homepage and adds several quality-of-life features.
